map.传播时间（t = d / c） 使用指南: Propagation Time (t = d / c) User Guide
map.输入天体距离，按 t=d/c 计算光从该处到达地球所需的时间，把天文距离换算成直: Enter a celestial distance and compute the time light takes to reach Earth as t = d/c, converting astronomical distance into intuitive years and months to feel cosmic space-time scale.
map.光在真空中走过某段距离所需时间。: Time light takes to travel a given distance in vacuum.
map.把天文距离换算成光走过所需的时间，直观感受宇宙的时空尺度。: Convert astronomical distance into the time light takes to cross it, for an intuitive feel of cosmic space-time scale.
map.计算行星际通信的单向延迟（如火星指令往返时延）。: Compute one-way delay for interplanetary communication (such as round-trip command delay to Mars).
map.在科普中对比「看 1 光年外就像看 1 年前」的回溯效应。: Compare in popular science the look-back effect that 'seeing 1 light-year away is like seeing 1 year ago'.
map.示例：太阳光到地球的时间: Example: time for sunlight to reach Earth
map.：日地平均距离约 1.496×10¹¹ m，c=2.998×10⁸ m/s，t=: : mean Earth-Sun distance about 1.496×10¹¹ m, c = 2.998×10⁸ m/s, t = d/c ≈ 499 s ≈ 8.3 minutes. So the Sun we see is the Sun of about 8 minutes ago.
map.为什么叫「光行时」？: Why is it called 'light travel time'?
map.信息以有限光速传播，观测到的远方天体其实是它过去的样子，距离越远看到的越早。: Information travels at a finite light speed, so a distant object we observe is really how it looked in the past; the farther away, the earlier the view.
map.1 光年≈9.46×10¹² km，约为日地距离的 63241 倍；最近的恒星比: 1 light-year ≈ 9.46×10¹² km, about 63,241 times the Earth-Sun distance; the nearest star, Proxima Centauri, is about 4.24 light-years away.
